name: Skyferry
subtitle: Plan hops through the storms
shortDescription: Read the storm forecast, hop a paper-lantern ferry between floating isles and bring every guest home. 100 charts, a Daily Run and Open Sky.
longDescription:
You are the harbour master of a small paper-lantern ferry that sails between floating isles at dusk. Each turn you do one thing: hop along a sky lane to a neighbouring isle, or drop anchor and wait. Board every guest, deliver every crate, and bring the ferry back to its home berth in as few turns as you can.

### The Weather Is Part Of The Puzzle
Every lane shows its forecast as a row of small pips. A storm pip closes the lane on that turn, a wind arrow makes it one-way, and the pattern repeats. Sometimes the best move is to wait. Finish in par turns for three stars; the par is the true shortest plan, worked out by our own solver, and every chart is verified winnable. Undo is unlimited and there are no timers and no lives.

### 100 Charts In Ten Worlds
Each world adds a new twist. Meadow Moorings teaches the basics, Squall Reach brings storms, Tailwind Straits one-way winds, Priority Pier guests with gold ribbons who must board in order 1, 2, 3, and Cargo Cove crates to carry between isles with a limited hold. In Twin Wake you steer two ferries that share the same lanes, and Gale Season, Merchant Run, Convoy Lanes and Skyfall Archipelago combine everything.

### A Run Every Day, And Open Sky
The Daily Run is the same chart for everyone on that date, with a streak that counts the days you finish it. Open Sky serves an endless, shuffled run through the whole chart pool when you just want to keep going.

### The Hangar
Earn lantern coins from the stars you win and spend them in the Hangar on ferry skins and flags. Nothing is random and nothing is for sale.

### Light And Calm
A dusk sky in indigo and persimmon, paper-cut isles with golden lanterns, soft bells and a reduce-motion switch. Works offline.
